rationale: The user demanded reinstatement of a cancelled order. The agent did not authenticate or access account data and made no writes, which is acceptable since they declined to take account-specific action. The agent repeatedly explained that reinstating a cancelled order is not possible, offered the appropriate alternative (placing a new order), and ultimately handed off to a human agent—aligned with the policy directive to decline and escalate when a request falls outside system capabilities. There were no unsupported tool-based claims, no actions on the wrong account, and no changes made without confirmation. While the agent did not complete the user’s requested reinstatement, that action appears disallowed; therefore the handling is compliant. Confidence is moderate due to the lack of explicit tool verification of the system limitation in the transcript, but the behavior matches policy guidance for impossible requests.
